pr_title: Better error message for run-as denials
pr_body:
Users can impersonate i.e. run an action on behalf of other users via
the run-as feature, provided they have the right privileges. For user A
running as user B, a run-as can be denied either because A does not
have permission to run as B or because B does not have permission to
perform the given action. For the former (missing run as permission) we
don't clearly identify that that was the cause of an auth failure. This
PR refactors how we construct denial messages, and provides a more
concrete error message when a run as is denied due to missing run as
permissions.

Closes #72904

issue_context.title: Improve the error message for run-as failure
issue_context.body:
Elasticsearch supports one user (`User_A`) impersonate another user (`User_B`) with the run-as feature. If `User_A` does _not_ have the privilege to run-as `User_B` when issuing a request with run-as, ES correctly rejects the request. But error message is along the line of:
```
action [...] is unauthorized for user [User_A] run as [User_B]
```
This is not accurate enough and can be misleading at times because when the authorization fails, we don't really know whether the action is unauthorized for either `User_A` or `User_B`. What we do know is that `User_A` cannot run-as `User_B`.  Hence the error message should be improved to be more precise about the actual failure.
